sections.bio: I help B2B & SaaS founders build a stronger presence, reach the right audience, and turn social media into a growth channel.🚀 What I do:• Product Hunt Launch Support & Promotion• LinkedIn Growth & Personal Branding• LinkedIn Content & Social Media Management• X (Twitter) Growth & Content Management• Reddit Marketing & Community Growth• Organic Audience & Engagement GrowthWith a growing 21K+ LinkedIn audience, I focus on creating authentic content, building meaningful communities, and helping startups get more visibility without relying only on paid promotion.I enjoy working with founders, SaaS teams, AI startups, and ambitious builders who want to build a strong personal and product brand online.🤝 Open to collaborations, partnerships & interesting projects.Feel free to connect or DM me — always happy to explore ways we can grow together

posts.text:
Product Hunt was built to help great products get discovered. But today, many founders feel that launch-day visibility depends as much on audience and distribution as it does on product quality.

In this edition, I break down the Product Hunt launch problem, why bootstrapped founders can struggle without a large audience or marketing budget, and how to build genuine demand before launch day.

If you’re planning a Product Hunt launch, this one is worth reading
